summary_en.motivation: To develop patient-specific additively manufactured prostheses for reconstructing large bone defects after tumor resection in pediatric patients.
summary_en.method: Electron beam melting was used to fabricate Ti-6Al-4V prostheses with body-centered cubic porous structures at interfaces, and biomechanical evaluation included finite element analysis and fatigue testing.
summary_en.result: The prosthesis withstood physiologically relevant loading with only 82 μm permanent deformation after 10^5 cycles at the porous surgical neck.
summary_en.validation: Micro-computed tomography confirmed the as-built morphology matched the design, and mechanical testing validated fatigue performance.

summary_zh.motivation: 昂贵有限元模拟的不确定性量化计算成本高，需要高效代理模型。
summary_zh.method: 提出FEM-NN混合模型，用有限元残差作为损失函数进行无监督训练。

summary_en.motivation: Uncertainty quantification in expensive finite element simulations requires efficient surrogate models that respect underlying physics.
summary_en.method: A hybrid FEM-informed neural network is proposed, where the discretized PDE residual computed from stiffness matrices and force vectors serves as a custom loss function, enabling unsupervised training without output data.
summary_en.result: The trained surrogate model accurately predicts quantities of interest and provides residual-based uncertainty estimates, significantly reducing the need for expensive FEM solves.
summary_en.validation: The framework is validated on a series of test cases by comparing Monte Carlo statistics with classical MC results.
